tours.title: Tours & excursions
tours.subtitle: Six carefully designed itineraries across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the east coast, with private transfers and expert local guides.

items.name: Historic & Futuristic Dubai
items.imageAlt: Wind towers and alleys of Al Bastakiya, historic Dubai by the Creek
items.description: The Dubai of yesterday and the Dubai of tomorrow in a single day: Jumeirah Mosque, the wind-tower lanes of Al Bastakiya, the spice and gold souks, an abra ride across the Creek and a grand finale at the Dubai Mall fountain.

items.name: Historic & Futuristic Dubai · Elite
items.imageAlt: Burj Khalifa and the Dubai skyline at sunset, the city washed in gold
items.description: The same route with another level of detail: a private guide, premium vehicle transfers, priority access to the Burj Khalifa observation deck and a signature dinner facing the illuminated fountain.

items.name: Dubai by Night
items.imageAlt: Illuminated Dubai skyline at night with light trails along the avenues
items.description: When the sun goes down Dubai changes its skin: Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai Marina, the Madinat Jumeirah souk and the Burj Khalifa fountain after dark, with a final drink on a rooftop overlooking the city.

items.name: Abu Dhabi · Manhattan
items.imageAlt: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in Abu Dhabi with its white domes
items.description: The Emirati capital and its glass skyline: the Corniche, Al Maryah Island and the financial district, crowned by the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.

items.name: Abu Dhabi · Louvre + Qasr Al Watan
items.imageAlt: Interior of Louvre Abu Dhabi beneath the dome and its rain of light
items.description: Art and power in one day: the rain of light under the Louvre Abu Dhabi dome and the marble halls of the presidential palace Qasr Al Watan.

items.name: Fujairah & the East Coast
items.imageAlt: Historic Fujairah fort with the Hajar Mountains behind it
items.description: The other emirate, where the desert meets the sea: the Hajar Mountains, the historic Fujairah fort and the turquoise waters of Khor Fakkan.

packages.title: Tailor-made programs & journeys
packages.subtitle: Five complete programs with flights, hotels and experiences already combined. All of them are customisable: we adjust nights, hotel category and activities to your own pace.

items.name: Stop Over Dubai
items.imageAlt: Dubai skyline at sunset seen from the main avenue
items.description: Two nights to fall in love with the city: private airport pickup, a 5* hotel in the centre, a panoramic city tour, the Burj Khalifa at sunset and your transfer back. Perfect for a long layover or a weekend.
includes: 2 nights in a 5* hotel with breakfast

items.name: Essential Dubai
items.imageAlt: Traditional abras sailing the Dubai Creek
items.description: The essentials of Dubai in four days: the historic and the modern city, the fountain show, a desert safari with dinner under the stars and free time in Dubai Marina.
includes: Guide and transfers in English & Spanish

items.name: 3 Emirates
items.imageAlt: Sharjah skyline facing Al Majaz lagoon in the United Arab Emirates
items.description: A journey through the three great emirates: Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. From the Burj Khalifa skyline to the domes of the Sheikh Zayed Mosque and the cultural heritage of Sharjah.
includes: Dubai: Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall

items.name: Madinat
items.imageAlt: Dubai at night with the Burj Khalifa illuminated
items.description: Our most complete route: a luxury hotel with views, a private sunset cruise along the Marina, a desert safari, a full day in Abu Dhabi and a special evening in Madinat Jumeirah.
includes: 6 nights in a 5* hotel with views

items.name: Family & Adventure
items.imageAlt: Dubai desert dunes, the setting of the 4x4 safari
items.description: A journey designed to be enjoyed as a family: a 4x4 safari over the dunes, water and theme parks, a beach day in Jumeirah and the fountain show to close every day.

about.title: Your Gateway to Luxury Travel
about.body1: For over a decade we have been crafting extraordinary travel experiences across the Middle East. Our team of expert travel consultants combines local knowledge with world-class service to create journeys that exceed expectations.
about.body2: From the golden dunes of Dubai to the ancient wonders of Egypt, we make sure every moment of your journey is nothing short of exceptional. Our partnerships with the finest hotels, airlines and local guides guarantee an experience that is both authentic and luxurious.
